startup.usernameHint: Leave empty to use the distribution’s default user.
startup.directoryHint: A Linux path, or ~ for the home directory.
startup.sessionHint: Each tab opens an independent session in your existing distribution.

interaction.copyHint: Copy selected text to the Windows clipboard.
interaction.pasteHint: In applications using the mouse, right-click is still sent to Linux. Shift+right-click forces paste.
interaction.scrollbackHint: Requested lines per tab, from 0 to 100,000. History memory is shared between tabs; opening or widening tabs can reduce retained lines.

appearance.description: Saved changes also apply to terminals that are already open.
appearance.fontHint: Choose a monospaced font installed in Windows.
appearance.schemesHint: Five color schemes for your sessions. Choose a look; font size and cursor settings stay unchanged.
appearance.fontsUnavailable: Font list unavailable: {{error}}. The current setting is kept.

management.description: View your distributions, manage their sessions and update WSL.
management.initialState: Open this page to load the WSL status.
management.pathsHint: The paths below are Windows paths. Importing and installing add a distribution; they do not replace an existing one.
management.exportHint: Choose a new file, for example D:\Backups\Debian.tar.
management.catalogHint: Use the name listed under “Available distributions”.
management.firstLaunchHint: After installation, open a terminal to finish setting up the Linux account if needed.
management.logPlaceholder: Messages from wsl.exe will appear here.
management.unavailable: Management is available in the Windows application.
management.defaultHint: The WSL default is shared with other applications; set the DooTTY default under General.
management.outputLimited: [Display limited to 1 MiB; the command continues.]
management.commandFailed: wsl.exe failed (code {{code}}). See the messages above.
management.enterExportPath: Enter the new Windows backup file path.
management.exportConfirmation: Create a backup of {{distribution}} at {{path}}. Existing files will be refused. Avoid changing its data during export.
management.defaultConfirmation: {{distribution}} will become the WSL default for commands that do not specify a distribution. The DooTTY default will stay unchanged.
management.stopConfirmation: All processes in {{distribution}} will be interrupted, including those started outside DooTTY. Save your work.
management.restartConfirmation: All processes in {{distribution}} will be interrupted, including those started outside DooTTY. Save your work. Its DooTTY terminals will be restarted; other applications will not be restored.
management.shutdownConfirmation: All distributions and the WSL 2 virtual machine will be stopped. Terminals, services and tools such as Docker using WSL will be interrupted. Save your work.
management.enterImportFields: Enter the name, backup file and new Windows folder.
management.importConfirmation: Create the distribution {{name}} in {{location}} from {{path}}. The name and folder must be new. The initial user of an import may be root.
management.enterInstallName: Enter the exact distribution name from the WSL catalog.
management.installConfirmation: Download and install {{name}}. No terminal will open automatically. Windows may request administrator rights.
management.restartCommandHint: Then restart the affected DooTTY terminals.
management.waitBeforeClosing: A WSL operation is in progress. Wait for its result before closing DooTTY.
management.adminRetry: Retry WSL update with administrator rights ↗
management.adminConsole: The update is running in a separate Windows console. Accept or cancel the UAC prompt; its result will be shown here.
management.adminConfirmation: Windows will ask for permission to run only wsl.exe --update --web-download as administrator, in a separate console. DooTTY and its terminals keep their normal permissions. You can decline the UAC prompt.
management.shutdownHint: Stops all distributions and the WSL2 VM without relaunching them. Each distribution’s Restart button stops it and then starts it again.

wsl.savedPathHint: WSL settings are managed in the Microsoft application. Save a new path before opening it.

storage.description: Find your distribution’s disk and access global WSL settings.
storage.registryHint: Information read from the Windows WSL registrations.
storage.sizeHint: The file size, space allocated by Windows and capacity shown in Linux may differ.
storage.configHint: Settings shared by WSL 2 distributions: memory, processors and other virtual machine options.
storage.locationHint: Location in your Windows user folder.
storage.noWriteHint: DooTTY only opens the existing file. It does not create or save it for you. WSL is not restarted.
storage.configFound: The file exists. You can open it in Notepad to edit it.
storage.configMissing: No .wslconfig file found. DooTTY does not create one automatically.
storage.wsl1: WSL 1 does not use a VHDX disk.
storage.sizeUnavailable: File not found or size unavailable

shortcuts.description: Ctrl+C, Ctrl+D and shell shortcuts are still sent to Linux.

about.heading: About DooTTY
about.description: A Windows client dedicated to your local WSL distributions.
about.technology: Interface inspired by Windows Terminal. xterm.js terminal, native ConPTY and WSL connection, built with Tauri and Rust.
about.icons: Distribution icons: Simple Icons and Linux projects. Sources and licenses are included in the archive notices.

settings.languageHint: Applies after saving, without closing your terminals.
settings.saved: Settings saved. Session settings apply to new tabs.
settings.saveUnavailable: Saving is available in the Windows application.

accessibility.menu: Choose a distribution and open the menu

tabs.unexpectedExit: WSL exited with an error. The diagnostic remains in this tab.
tabs.stillConnecting: A terminal is still connecting. Restart it after it disconnects.
tabs.previewHint: Run DooTTY.exe on Windows to open WSL.

input.tooLarge: Input is too large: wait for the current paste to finish.

updates.unchecked: Synced when settings are first opened.
updates.sourceHint: Automatically checked when settings are first opened, cached until DooTTY closes. Use sync to check again. Updating requires confirmation.
updates.updateAvailable: A newer stable version is available. Read its release notes before updating.
updates.upToDate: Your version matches the latest stable version published on GitHub.
updates.newerInstalled: Your installed version is newer than the latest stable release. No downgrade is offered.
updates.cannotCompare: Cannot compare versions. Available information is still shown; you can try again.
updates.remoteError: GitHub version unavailable (network or rate limit): {{error}}
updates.checkFirst: Check versions first. A newer stable version must be available before updating.
updates.confirmUpdate: Installed version: {{installed}}. Latest stable version published on GitHub: {{available}}. The command will download the latest stable version available on GitHub when it runs. Linux packages are not affected. An internet connection is required; Windows may request administrator rights.

general.description: Language, launch, clipboard and application behavior.
general.trimCopyHint: Preserve indentation and spaces within the text.
general.trimPasteHint: Clean each line without changing its indentation or spaces between words.
general.trimNewlinesHint: Prevent a final newline from immediately running a pasted command. Internal line breaks are preserved.
general.rectangleHint: Select columns by dragging the mouse. Alt+drag is still available temporarily; Shift forces selection in applications that use the mouse.
general.rectangleMenuHint: Toggle this mode for the current tab only.
general.warnCloseHint: Ask for confirmation before closing a window containing multiple terminals.
general.monitoringHint: Shows the panel and samples the active distribution. Disabling stops new queries; a query already in progress may still finish.

closing.single: Close this window and its terminal sessions?
closing.unsaved: Settings changes have not been saved.
